audit.why: Levels 1-3 to Pantheon and 4 onward to Cassiopeia matches both layers, the 54.22% Emerald+ rate over 83 games and the kits: his spike is a 13s targeted leap-stun, hers is a 0.75s recast that only gets stronger with ranks and items. No stage side needed changing.

audit.whatIsWrong: Neither layer carries a single cooldown. The level 6 spike says only "stun him mid-leap" without saying what dodging or cancelling actually buys you.
audit.why: Shield Vault at 13s rank 1 is the gap-close and the entire spacing clock; Aegis Assault at 22s rank 1 is the shield window Petrifying Gaze can delete. Those two numbers turn "respect the all-in" into a countable plan.
audit.corrected: 13s on Shield Vault and 22s on Aegis Assault written into spikes[0].text, spikes[2].text, wants.you[1] and early.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two interactions are stated wrong and one decisive one is absent. (a) Both layers say Aegis Assault "blocks your autos" — it blocks damage from the front, so it eats Twin Fang too, and stepping around him beats it entirely. (b) early and wants.you[1] say Miasma grounds "his W/E dashes"; only Shield Vault is a dash, Aegis Assault is a stationary channel. (c) Aegis Assault is a channel and Petrifying Gaze cancels it outright — never stated anywhere.
audit.why: Riot: Aegis Assault — "Pantheon sets his shield, becoming invulnerable to damage from the front and striking repeatedly with his spear"; the kit file flags it channel, "interruptible — any CC cancels it". Shield Vault is the only ability flagged dash. Petrifying Gaze is hardCC.
audit.corrected: Frontal-only blocking, the Shield-Vault-only grounding, and the R-cancels-the-channel line all written in.

audit.whatIsWrong: Shield Vault is an auto-attack reset and neither layer says so.
audit.why: The kit file flags W autoReset. The wind-up, not the cast, is the cue to step out of range.
audit.corrected: Left for a later pass — no field in the length band had room without dropping the frontal-block correction, which matters more.

edits.before: His danger window — Pantheon's targeted W leap-stun into a melee Q (and a Mortal Will empowered spear) chunks you before your poison ramps, and his E (Aegis Assault) blocks your return autos, so respect the all-in.
edits.after: His danger window — Shield Vault (W) is a targeted leap-stun on 13s into a melee Q, and Aegis Assault (E) blocks damage from the front only, so walk around his shield rather than feed Twin Fang into it.

edits.before: Petrifying Gaze (R) answers his all-in: stun him mid-leap or as he commits W, then chain Twin Fang while he's locked and his gap-close is down.
edits.after: Petrifying Gaze (R) answers him twice: stun him out of Shield Vault, and it cancels the Aegis Assault channel — 22s before that shield returns.

edits.before: Ground him with W (Miasma) the instant he leaps in so his W/E dashes are disabled and his all-in stalls while you kite
edits.after: Ground him with W (Miasma) the moment he leaps so Shield Vault is dead for 13s and his all-in stalls while you kite

edits.before: All-in you with his combo while his E (Aegis Assault) blocks your autos and you're still squishy and low-rank
edits.after: All-in you and turn Aegis Assault (E) to face you, blocking frontal damage while you are still squishy and low-rank

edits.before: His W leap-stuns you on lock (no dodge) and his E blocks your autos — with one ability up and no poison stacked, you lose the level-1 trade outright.
edits.after: Shield Vault leap-stuns you on lock and Aegis Assault blocks frontal damage — with one ability up and no poison stacked, you lose the level-1 trade outright.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are his, not yours — Pantheon's W is a targeted leap that stuns (no skillshot to dodge), and out of it he lands a melee Q plus a Mortal Will empowered spear while his E (Aegis Assault) blocks your return autos. Don't walk into spear range to throw a Q he can just W-stun you out of; last-hit at the back of the wave and accept a little poke. Hold your W (Miasma) ground for the moment he commits — it grounds his W/E dashes — not for chip poke, and never trade into a full mana bar at level 1-2.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are his, not yours — Shield Vault (W) is a targeted leap-stun on 13s with no skillshot to dodge, and out of it he lands a melee Q plus a Mortal Will empowered spear while Aegis Assault (E) blocks damage from the front. Don't walk into spear range to throw a Q he can just W-stun you out of; last-hit at the back of the wave and accept a little poke. Hold your W (Miasma) for the leap itself — grounding kills Shield Vault, his one gap-close — not for chip poke, and never trade into a full mana bar at level 1-2.

notes: _missing-interactions.json flags Aegis Assault as untargetable-dodges-burst. Riot's own text says "invulnerable to damage from the front", not untargetable, so I wrote the frontal rule and did not repeat the untargetable claim. The channel-cancel line rests on the kit file flag channel: "interruptible — any CC cancels it" rather than on tested behaviour.
